hybridLibrary.authority: ADR 097 owner mobile correction, October 9. It supersedes pair caps/grid, automatic deepest branch, detached evidence, data-response keyed navigation entries and always-present mascot rules in ADRs 095-096 where they conflict.
hybridLibrary.geometry: 1040px Library cap with 20px inset, removed at 760px and below. Adjacent representation and filing switches in a stationary two-segment toolbar capped at 600px. One authored filing root, ordered horizontally scrollable 170px sibling cards, 148px on phones. Measured SVG connects actual category rectangles and omits hidden levels; proposals appear inside expanded insight rows.
hybridLibrary.responsive: Final mobile override at 760px. Categories have 56px minimum height, 52px in Folders. Stacked insight buttons have 80px minimum height and 42px icons, reduced to 36px on phones. Compact 11/12/13/14/15px type and 9/10/12px control radii intentionally retain operative density. Same five fixed bottom controls on all pages; mobile top Account and Home mascot removed. Actual favicon links Home; authenticated HTTPS OAuth picture falls back to first-name initial. Save label uses theme Subtle; dark ink applies only to the yellow 48px SVG.
hybridLibrary.pagination: Six initial returned insights in both Tree and Folders. More insights reveals six more; Next insights page explicitly requests the next authorized page.
hybridLibrary.boundary: Filing changes organization independently of authorized access scope. Empty templates have no evidence or grant. Project connections start only after an actual insight click, reuse a bounded current-topic cache and filter exact current references; a proposal link grants no coding authority.
hybridLibrary.verification: Final private/mobile-navigation-final-browser-20261009.json reports synthetic local native browser PASS at requested/actual widths 320,390,412,768,1440,1600, inline Tree/Folders evidence, stable controls, one-level/sequential motion, keyboard/reduced-motion behavior and actual Account destinations. Fresh full reviewer handoff found dark Save label and stale documentation; both have corrections, with final reviewer disposition pending. Exact production, physical-device smoothness, independent comprehension, actual OAuth picture delivery, provider/cost settlement and full V1 acceptance remain separate.
hybridLibrary.compactEvidence: Compact first-clause excerpt with a 40-character/seven-word budget after the first word, plus ellipsis when shortened. Full claim remains unchanged in the inspection aria label and expanded row; full source title, source link and exact recorded proposals expand inside that same row. Demo excerpts abbreviate Synthetic example to Example while the synthetic banner and full title retain context.
hybridLibrary.motion: Sequential 220ms outgoing close and incoming open phases; insight expansion 200ms; height/opacity with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Hidden content is immediately inert and aria-hidden. Keyboard and live system/app motion suppression are immediate. Evidence arrival resets only evidence by topic/generation/revision and does not remount navigation. Workspace/scope changes still reset private state. No inference or recurring browse polling comes from motion.
hybridLibrary.history: Earlier ADR 095/096 pair/grid composition, preceding 78% drift FAIL/hard veto, five prior stacked captures, animation counts and production releases are historical within their original scopes, not current composition rules or acceptance for ADR 097.

narrative.overview:
The app uses cool canvas, white reading surfaces, navy ink and teal selection. Its matching dark theme keeps the same hierarchy. Quiet borders and compact icon-led cards let saved knowledge and the next permitted action lead. Device setting is the default appearance; Account offers Light and Dark overrides.

This is the owner-authorized October 9 application world, extracted from the built code. Its boundary is the Atlas shell, Home, Library, Projects, Account and capture. The public marketing world remains Scroll's charcoal studio. The app logo uses the actual favicon artwork and links to Home. Home and the mobile header no longer show the mascot or top account control under [ADR 097](docs/adr/097-stable-mobile-library-navigation.md). Original Scroll artwork remains part of the public marketing identity; this correction introduces no shipping raster artwork. Product authority remains in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md), with the selected interaction scope in [the Atlas implementation contract](docs/design/ATLAS-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT-20261009.md).

Current local evidence is private/mobile-navigation-final-browser-20261009.json, synthetic native browser PASS at 320/390/412/768/1440/1600. The nine mobile/desktop/theme/page captures remain synthetic proof. Final reviewer disposition and exact production acceptance for ADR 097 remain pending; preceding releases, ADR 095/096 and the grid 78% FAIL are historical.
keyCharacteristics: Cool light and matching dark surfaces with teal selection.
Favicon Home link and current authenticated account avatar.
Ordered scrollable sibling rows and one-level category opening.
Inline unchanged insight evidence and exact recorded proposals.
Five stable phone controls: Home, Library, Save, Projects, Account.
Sequential pointer branch motion with immediate keyboard and reduced-motion actions.
Loaded-record statistics and separate recorded project outcomes.

rules.name: The Recorded Meaning Rule
rules.body: Selection and connectors describe returned records; neither color nor a line establishes permission, independent corroboration or benefit.

rules.name: The Reading Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Retain the compact 11/12/13/14/15px operative scale while keeping title, claim and metadata distinct. Compact type does not reduce hit areas.

rules.name: The Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls keep at least a 44px target; small type and icons do not justify a smaller hit area. Informational chips are not controls.

rules.name: The Cited Group Rule
rules.body: Display a connection only when all of its exact source, generation, revision and insight references exist in current permitted evidence. A connection is an explained cited group; neither its line nor topic membership proves causation or agreement.

rules.name: The Recorded Outcome Rule
rules.body: Present saving, evaluation, issue, PR, merge, deployment and benefit as separate recorded facts. A judgment is not a measured comparison, and a merged PR alone does not establish benefit.

rules.name: The Stable Navigation Rule
rules.body: Keep every returned sibling in saved order. Open one level on category selection, close the outgoing pointer branch before opening the next and preserve mounted navigation when evidence arrives. Reset evidence separately on topic, generation and revision.

dos: **Do** use existing theme colors and color-mix selection/icon tints.
**Do** retain compact 11/12/13/14/15px type and 9/10/12px control radii for operative density.
**Do** use the favicon Home link and authenticated HTTPS OAuth picture or first-name initial.
**Do** keep the same five bottom controls on every app page and open the existing Account dropdown upward.
**Do** use theme Subtle for Save labels in both themes and dark ink only on the yellow SVG.
**Do** keep visible keyboard focus, 44px controls and live reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** load bounded project links only after an actual insight click and filter exact current references.
donts: **Don't** turn filing templates or proposal links into access or coding authority.
**Don't** reorder siblings, automatically open the deepest branch, detach row evidence or remount navigation on detail arrival.
**Don't** restore the removed Home mascot or mobile top account control.
**Don't** make pointer motion delay keyboard reading or action.
**Don't** treat historical ADR 095/096/grid 78% FAIL or prior releases as current composition rules.
**Don't** turn synthetic browser proof or a scoped review into exact production or full V1 acceptance.
